title: Orthoptists
description: Diagnose and treat visual system disorders such as binocular vision and eye movement impairments.

projection.title: Healthcare diagnosing or treating practitioners, all other

tasks.text: Evaluate, diagnose, or treat disorders of the visual system with an emphasis on binocular vision or abnormal eye movements.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI suggests differentials; clinician examines and owns diagnosis

tasks.text: Examine patients with problems related to ocular motility, binocular vision, amblyopia, or strabismus.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Vision tests require hands-on patient examination

dwas.name: Examine patients to assess general physical condition.

tasks.text: Perform diagnostic tests or measurements, such as motor testing, visual acuity testing, lensometry, retinoscopy, and color vision testing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Vision tests require hands-on patient examination

tasks.text: Provide nonsurgical interventions, including corrective lenses, patches, drops, fusion exercises, or stereograms, to treat conditions such as strabismus, heterophoria, and convergence insufficiency.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Chronic disease management needs clinical judgment

tasks.text: Develop nonsurgical treatment plans for patients with conditions such as strabismus, nystagmus, and other visual disorders.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Medical plans need exam, liability, and clinical judgment

tasks.text: Provide instructions to patients or family members concerning diagnoses or treatment plans.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Results delivery needs empathy and clinical judgment

dwas.name: Explain medical procedures or test results to patients or family members.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Interpret clinical or diagnostic test results.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Image interpretation assists; radiologist owns diagnosis

dwas.name: Analyze test data or images to inform diagnosis or treatment.

tasks.text: Refer patients to ophthalmic surgeons or other physicians.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Clinical referral judgment needs licensed human accountability

dwas.name: Refer patients to other healthcare practitioners or health resources.

tasks.text: Develop or use special test and communication techniques to facilitate diagnosis and treatment of children or patients with disabilities.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Assessment methods drafted; clinical validation human

dwas.name: Develop health assessment methods or programs.

tasks.text: Provide training related to clinical methods or orthoptics to students, resident physicians, or other health professionals.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Provider training is clinical, hands-on, accountable

tasks.text: Collaborate with ophthalmologists, optometrists, or other specialists in the diagnosis, treatment, or management of conditions such as glaucoma, cataracts, and retinal diseases.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Treatment planning collaboration is accountable clinical work

dwas.name: Collaborate with healthcare professionals to plan or provide treatment.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Prepare diagnostic or treatment reports for other medical practitioners or therapists.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Summarize diagnostic and care activities into reports

dwas.name: Prepare reports summarizing patient diagnostic or care activities.

tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Literature review aided; wet-lab and clinical research human

dwas.name: Conduct research to increase knowledge about medical issues.

tasks.text: Assist ophthalmologists in diagnostic ophthalmic procedures, such as ultrasonography, fundus photography, and tonometry.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on assistance during examinations

dwas.name: Assist healthcare practitioners during examinations or treatments.

tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Medical research presentation needs human delivery

tasks.text: Perform vision screening of children in schools or community health centers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Vision tests require hands-on patient examination
